rationale: Selected open_tie_13 and shed_bus3_15 to resolve l12 overload (118→96 MW) with minimal load shedding (15 MW). Opening l13 reduces l12 by 8 MW but leaves it at 110 MW (still overloaded). Adding shed_bus3_15 reduces l12 by another 14 MW to 96 MW, within the 100 MW limit. Total shed is 15 MW, which is better than the alternative combination (shed_bus3_15 + shed_bus2_10 = 25 MW shed).
